warning: Neural similarity is not confidence. Sen slope is the median of all observed pairwise slopes; intercept is median(value − slope × day). Endpoint baseline joins earliest and latest approved points. Residual flags use your supplied absolute tolerance, not statistical significance or automatic outlier removal. Leave-one-out errors refit without each point, including endpoint extrapolation; they are in-sample diagnostic comparisons, not validated forecast accuracy. Serial dependence, seasonality, changing exposure and majority contamination can invalidate interpretation. No extrapolation or causal claim; holds and unavailable series remain in audits.
